title: 2027 Toyota Corolla Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: The 2027 Toyota Corolla has a new exterior color option as the model celebrates its 60th year, but it's otherwise a carryover.
body_markdown:
The Toyota Corolla celebrates 60 years in 2027, and this current model is part of the 12th generation, which was introduced in 2020. Sitting in the compact-car class, the Corolla’s primary competitors include the Honda Civic, the Hyundai Elantra, the Kia K4, and the Mazda3. The 2027 Toyota Corolla has three trims: LE, SE, and XSE.

## What’s New for the 2027 Toyota Corolla


The Toyota Corolla had a mid-cycle refresh in 2023, which included new front and rear styling, more standard safety tech, an updated infotainment system, and a simplified engine lineup. There's a new black exterior paint option called Inked for the 2027 model year, but the Corolla is otherwise a carryover model.


## Design


The Corolla has compact sedan styling and adopts the trapezoidal grille and slender headlights seen throughout the Toyota lineup. The base LE has 16-inch steel wheels, and 16-inch alloys are available. There are standard 18-inch alloy wheels starting at the SE trim level. There are no appearance packages on the Corolla, but the SE and XSE trims both offer a two-tone paint option with an “Inked” (i.e. black) roof.


## Powertrain


With the redesign in 2023, Toyota dropped the old base 1.8-liter engine as well as the manual transmission from the Corolla sedan lineup. Now the only gas powertrain option is a 169-horsepower 2.0-liter four-cylinder engine paired with a dynamic-shift continuously variable transmission (CVT). There is also a hybrid powertrain option, but we cover that in a separate article. The gas-only Corolla sedan is front-wheel drive and the most fuel-efficient model, the LE, gets 32 mpg in the city, 41 mpg on the highway, and 35 mpg in combined driving. Both the SE and XSE deliver 34 mpg in combined driving.


## Interior


The 2027 Toyota Corolla seats five, but as a compact sedan it’s better suited to four. Cargo capacity rings in at 13.1 cubic feet, which is the least amount of space offered by any of the competitors in the compact car class. Thankfully, there are 60/40 split fold-down rear seats, which creates a little flexibility. Cloth seating surfaces are standard, with synthetic leather seats becoming standard on the top XSE trim. It’s also worth noting that the rear seat has a standard pull-down center armrest with cup holders, which isn't always the case on a base trim. Moonroofs are reserved for the XSE trim.


## Technology


The Toyota Corolla proves that “compact” and “entry-level” don’t mean no tech. Standard features include an 8-inch infotainment screen with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, LED headlights and taillights, Service and Safety Connect with a five-year trial, two front and two rear USB-C ports, and a 7-inch digital gauge cluster. Connected services such as cloud-based navigation, remote start, destination assistant, and a Wi-Fi hotspot are available for a subscription fee. Other available tech features include a 10.5-inch infotainment screen, a nine-speaker JBL premium audio system, wireless phone charging, and a 12.3-inch digital gauge cluster.

## Safety


The addition of the Toyota Safety Sense 3.0 suite was one of the big updates in the Corolla's 2023 refresh. This includes a pre-collision system with pedestrian detection, lane-departure warning with steering assist, high-beam assist, adaptive cruise control, lane-trace assist, proactive driving assist, and traffic-sign assist. Other standard safety features include blind-spot monitors, rear cross-traffic alert, tire pressure monitoring, and LATCH lower anchors on outboard rear seats and tether anchors on all rear seats. There are so many standard safety features on the Corolla that there are no optional upgrades. Neither the Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) nor the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) had tested the 2027 Corolla at the time of writing. The IIHS gave the 2026 model mostly Good ratings, with one Marginal result in the moderate front overlap test. The NHTSA gave the 2025 Corolla a maximum five-star overall safety rating.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2027 Toyota Corolla is on sale now and Toyota listed the price for the base LE trim at $24,620 (including delivery, processing, and handling fee) at the time of writing. Other than premium paint colors ($475), the only package option available on this trim is the LE Premium Package for $1,135, which includes push-button start, passive entry, 16-inch alloy wheels, and wireless phone charger. The SE starts at $27,060 and offers the two-tone paint option ($500) as well as premium paint options. This trim also offers the SE Premium Package for $965, which includes the wireless phone charger, 12.3-inch digital cluster, and 10.5-inch infotainment screen. The top-tier XSE starts at $30,335, and it also offers the two-tone and premium paint options. The only option on this model is the JBL premium audio system for $600.
